chunks: Say: "O people of the Book, why do you turn away the believers from the path of God, seeking to make it crooked, while you are witnesses? And God is not unaware of what you do."
ai.seo_question: Why do the People of the Book try to turn believers away from the path of God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as addressing the Jews and Christians who, despite possessing the Torah and Gospel that testify to the prophethood of Muhammad (PBUH), obstructed the path of truth due to sectarian pride or political expediency. The term 'shuhada' (witnesses) underscores their role as bearers of prior revelation who recognized the signs of the final Prophet yet chose to distort the message. This highlights the Shia emphasis on the continuity of divine guidance and the accountability of those who know the truth but actively mislead others.
